answer: A jetty-like escrow ledger holds deposits, slashing them if correlated behavior reveals one operator behind many accounts. Agents stake ferrous tokens bonded to a unique registered reputation slot and post a quartz-mining proof-of-work challenge per epoch; duplicate identities must independently burn compute and stake. Attackers thus pay escalating capital plus wasted energy for each fake identity, making sybil farming costlier than honest participation. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
